result.summary: Screen is largely intact; found 3 minor visual issues: abrupt horizontal clipping on the right edge, inconsistent favorite-icon styling, and inconsistent time/price label formatting.

issues.description: Right-edge carousel items are abruptly clipped: 'Trattoria Piccol' title is cut mid-word, its '20-30 min' badge is truncated by screen edge, and the far-right category pill is cut in half with no end padding or fade.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing scroll padding and a peek/fade indicator to horizontal carousels so clipped cards clearly signal scrollability and text and badges are not cut mid-character.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons in 'Popular right now' have inconsistent treatment: ramen card shows plain white outline with no background, while pizza card shows white outline on a dark circular scrim.
issues.suggestion: Unify the favorite button style with consistent size, circular background/scrim, contrast and hit area across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Time and delivery labels use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' vs '20-30 min' hyphen spacing and '€0 delivery' vs '€0.90 delivery' price style.
issues.suggestion: Standardize time-range dash/spacing and delivery-price formatting across badges and subtitles.
